en: The Mahāyāna Vaipulya Essential Wisdom Sūtra, translated by the Tripiṭaka Master An Shigao of Parthia during the Later Han Dynasty.
Thus have I heard: At one time, the Buddha was traveling in the kingdom of Śrāvastī. At that time, Maitreya Bodhisattva...
Joining his palms, he addressed the Buddha, saying:
"World-Honored One!
I wish to ask a small question; if the World-Honored One permits my inquiry, I shall venture to set it forth."
The Buddha said, “If you have any doubts, ask them; I shall explain them for you so that your mind may be filled with joy.
Maitreya asked:

"How does a bodhisattva mahāsattva abide in the dharma of non-retrogression, so that within the Great Vehicle they advance without diminution, practice the bodhisattva path while subduing Māra and his enmity, and according to their actual condition, fully instruct others in the characteristics of the roots of all dharmas; how do they not weary of birth and death, possess their own right wisdom without receiving it from another, and swiftly attain the unsurpassed stage of omniscience?"
The World-Honored One praised him, saying:
"Excellent! Excellent!"
Your inquiry is appropriate, most excellent and well-spoken; I shall explain for you the practices attained by Bodhisattvas, which surpass what you have asked.
Listen attentively!
"Reflect upon this well!
Thereupon Maitreya received the instruction and listened with single-minded concentration.
The Buddha addressed Maitreya:
“If a bodhisattva is fully endowed with eight qualities, they will swiftly attain the unsurpassed stage of all-knowledge (sarvajñatā-bhūmi). What are these eight?
First, the internal nature is pure.”
Second, the accomplishment of conduct;
third, the accomplishment of giving;
fourth, the accomplishment of aspirations.
Fifth, the accomplishment of loving-kindness;
sixth, the accomplishment of compassion;
seventh, the accomplishment of skillful means.
Eighth is the accomplishment of wisdom.
These are the eight matters by which a bodhisattva swiftly attains the unsurpassed all-knowledge.
Maitreya Bodhisattva and the entire assembly were filled with joy.
*The Mahāyāna Vaipulya Essential Wisdom Sūtra*.
